svg.aria-label: Flow from open data sources through one pipeline into five analysis layers, the geo-AI index and shortlists, and the decisions a planner, a health worker and the proposed SMS bridge to Doctors Without Borders make; guardrails apply on every path and new data flows back in.
svg.text: one grid, one licence per file, cross-checked
five layers on the same 10 × 10 km squares
index, shortlists, AI readings of the figures

g.text: SMS bridge to Doctors Without Borders
1 Clinic texts a question, free (donor-paid line)
2 AI: urgency, Somali → English, names blocked
3 A volunteer doctor (MSF member) replies here
4 Reply goes back by SMS, in Somali
5 Logged: which facility, which doctor, when
6 Question → a dot on the map, the need layer

svg.text: new data flows back in: SMS questions and answers → need layer · confirmed voice clips → open Somali and Af-Maay speech data · Ministry Master Facility List (2026) loaded the day it is public

g.text: A person makes the call · "Not sure — ask a person" instead of a guess · no patient name or number in any message or file · every answer carries its source and date · model files ≤ 41 MB, core feature works offline · one language named (Somali), its gap named (Af-Maay)
